mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the pulling threads was the most worthwhile moment because it connected the earlier cell machinery to the muscle cells' ability to produce tension.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the nuclei was less engaging because the slot made the action predictable, though the explanation about copying instructions was useful.

surprise.text: The distinction between adding mitochondria and supplying their fuel changed my understanding of what the assembled model still needs.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the named slots and compatible options made their purposes clear.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how these muscle cells connect to tissues and how their supplies reach them.
